Write tests from BDD scenario SCN-01: booking two services - confirmed immediately; duration = sum; cost = sum; confirmation page shown; exactly one confirmation SMS. Human reviews expectations against ACs before features start.
Cancelling minutes before the appointment succeeds; status becomes cancelled; no fee; no error at any notice period.
Reschedule to a new slot updates time on the same record; 24h reminder = new time - 24h; 2h = new time - 2h; exactly one reschedule SMS recorded.
Booking <24h before: 24h reminder status skipped; <2h before: both reminders skipped. Never sent retroactively.
Disabled channel for an event type means no notification of that type; toggling one channel/event combo leaves others unchanged; admin notified for any master's event unless disabled.
Payment recording rejected for an appointment not marked completed; succeeds after completion (amount/status paid/unpaid/method).
Fresh installation offers Hair/Coloring/Barbering; a service can be saved with a category not among them; new category becomes selectable.
Weekly recurring pattern and one-off date-specific slot both take effect for booking; combined correctly.

Summary: Test reports: revenue / popular services / stock (SCN-10/14/15)
Description: SCN-10: preset (day/week/month) and custom from/to range both return revenue totals limited to that window. SCN-14: popular-services query returns services ordered by descending booking count within the period. SCN-15: stock-levels query returns each material's current quantity, unaffected by any period parameter.
A reminder recorded as skipped becomes scheduled again if a reschedule moves its time into the future; then sent normally.
Administrator receives no notification for their own create/edit/cancel action; the assigned master still receives theirs.
Multi-service booking with summed duration 75 min occupies a 90-min block (round UP to next 30-min boundary).
Token unguessable (UUID); responsive mobile layout; English-only UI; UAH amounts; indefinite retention; privacy boundaries; no location/tz selector; 30-min boundaries; no payment gateway.

Summary: Test auth and reference-data CRUD checks
Description: Master cannot self-register; admin single account; master calendar only own appointments; MasterService list matches; reference-data create/edit/deactivate; deactivate hides from new selection but keeps history; admin-created appointment mirrors booking rules; material transaction updates stock; custom unit savable.
Master accounts created by administrator (no self-registration); single administrator account; login/password auth for both.

CRUD for masters/services/MasterService prices/materials; free-form categories with seeds Hair/Coloring/Barbering; units ml/l/g/kg/pcs plus custom; deactivate = removed from new selection, history preserved.
Availability as recurring weekly pattern and/or specific dates; both combine and gate bookable slots.
Multi-service selection with summed duration/cost; slots only within master availability and not booked; auto-confirmed on creation; durations round UP to 30-min boundary for occupancy.

Confirmation page right after booking with cancel/reschedule links; reachable later via SMS link; exactly one confirmation SMS; unguessable (UUID) access token; page/token stay valid read-only after cancellation.
Cancel via link, free of charge, any notice period including minutes before; no cancellation SMS (page reflects status).
Reschedule via link, free, unlimited times; reminder times recalculated from new time; exactly one reschedule SMS with updated details and link to the same page.

24h and 2h reminder SMS; skip if scheduled time already passed at booking/reschedule (recorded as skipped, never sent retroactively); reactivation when reschedule moves a skipped reminder into the future.

Master and admin notified on create/reschedule/cancel via SMS and/or in-app per independent per-channel/per-event preferences; acting administrator receives no notification for their own action; assigned master still notified.
Logged-in master sees only own appointments' calendar; sees exactly own MasterService records (services + own prices).
Admin creates/edits/cancels appointments; admin time/master edits apply the same reminder recalculation and client updated-details SMS as a client reschedule.
Record receipt/issue transactions (date, quantity); each updates the material stock level.
Admin marks appointment completed (status completed); payment (amount, paid/unpaid, method) recordable ONLY after completion.

Revenue for preset periods (day/week/month) and custom date range (REQ-F-022); popular-services report ranked by booking count for the same period options (REQ-F-032); current material stock levels as a point-in-time snapshot, no period parameter (REQ-F-033).

Responsive mobile layout (booking form/confirmation page/cancel-reschedule usable without horizontal scroll); English-only; UAH on all amounts; client data visible only to authorized parties; no location/time-zone controls.
No automatic deletion/archiving of appointments and payments; no payment-provider redirect or API call anywhere.
